effect_branches.authoring_oracle: Printed Gas Guzzler red is a Mechanologist attack action with cost3, power6, and exactly Boost. CR8.3.9 makes banishing the top deck card optional additional cost; banishing a Mechanologist grants this attack go again, while other top cards do not. Empty deck prevents paying Boost but does not prevent ordinary play. Dash young has only an optional start-game item setup ability, and no item is started in these main-phase fixtures. No Hyper Driver, Teklo Pounder, High Octane, equipment or other boost modifiers exist. Deck begins ['zero_to_sixty_blue', 'raging_onslaught_red']; after all costs are paid it must be ['raging_onslaught_red'], with banish count1. Pitch Wounding Blow blue for3 after the Boost decision, paying3, leaving0. Before opponent priority, banish/payment are complete, source is still Stack, AP0/resources0. Printed power6 deals6; no extra hit/on-play abilities are printed. Resulting defender life14; source go again=True; AP after resolution1. Ordinary Boost grants no permission to play its zero-cost banished card; while AP1 and resources suffice, that play must still reject.  Payment-order correction from independent review: the Boost modal declares the optional cost early (CR5.1.3b). With positive resource cost, accepting before pitching leaves original Deck intact/Banish0, AP1/resources0 and priority1. Pay resource/AP asset costs first (CR5.1.7-8), then actually banish the top card as the effect-cost (CR5.1.9), before opponent priority. The two action checkpoints detect eager banishing before pitch, but same-action post-payment outcomes alone do not establish internal AP-before-banish ordering; a paired shared-path witness must cover that internal order.

Class-matching young dorinthea, no talents, no weapons and distinct equipment slots. Each of 4 equipment contributes defense1, total4, so plain4attack deals0. All remain live through Resolution; each independently destroys during automatic Close. No duplicate physical card is inferred from membership: every cardID is distinct and count pins multiplicity.

independent_review.review_basis: Exact approved saved-fixture rows inherited without altered row fields; source independent review preserved verbatim. Runtime qualification is separate.

Dynamic keyword loss/restoration/grants/cannot-gain/provenance, early Close/Phantasm and departure before normal link cleanup are separate interaction paths.

effect_branches.authoring_oracle: Start with one existing Quicken token and Wounding Blow red in hand. The first attack receives no Ira second-attack bonus. Pay its zero resources and one AP to play the attack. Quicken triggers and is a separate layer: Stack2/Arena1, and the attacking Stack-0 has no granted TurnEffects yet. Resolving the trigger destroys Quicken and grants GO_AGAIN to the still-pending attack: Stack1/Arena0, AP remains0. The attack then resolves to the combat chain with power4 and go again. After unblocked damage4, opponent life16 and AP1. This isolates Quicken timing independently of Flock creation or payment. Token boundary CR8.1.8a: destroyed Quicken is removed from the game, so it never remains in Graveyard; explicit graveyard counts verify this.

cards.name: Throttle
cards.functional_text: Boost

effect_branches.authoring_oracle: Printed Throttle red is a Mechanologist attack action with cost2, power6, and exactly Boost. CR8.3.9 makes banishing the top deck card optional additional cost; banishing a Mechanologist grants this attack go again, while other top cards do not. Empty deck prevents paying Boost but does not prevent ordinary play. Dash young has only an optional start-game item setup ability, and no item is started in these main-phase fixtures. No Hyper Driver, Teklo Pounder, High Octane, equipment or other boost modifiers exist. Deck begins ['zero_to_sixty_blue', 'raging_onslaught_red']; after all costs are paid it must be ['raging_onslaught_red'], with banish count1. Pitch Wounding Blow blue for3 after the Boost decision, paying2, leaving1. Before opponent priority, banish/payment are complete, source is still Stack, AP0/resources1. Printed power6 deals6; no extra hit/on-play abilities are printed. Resulting defender life14; source go again=True; AP after resolution1. Ordinary Boost grants no permission to play its zero-cost banished card; while AP1 and resources suffice, that play must still reject.  Payment-order correction from independent review: the Boost modal declares the optional cost early (CR5.1.3b). With positive resource cost, accepting before pitching leaves original Deck intact/Banish0, AP1/resources0 and priority1. Pay resource/AP asset costs first (CR5.1.7-8), then actually banish the top card as the effect-cost (CR5.1.9), before opponent priority. The two action checkpoints detect eager banishing before pitch, but same-action post-payment outcomes alone do not establish internal AP-before-banish ordering; a paired shared-path witness must cover that internal order.

Link RESOLUTION is bounded; no additional Close coverage claimed.
independent_review.qualification: Exact saved-fixture semantic review; clean replay and controls have separate runtime qualification. Does not mean every full-family fixture was manually inspected.

effect_branches.authoring_oracle: During the continuing Reaction Step, top Razor resolves above pending Dodge. One actual turn-player pass gives attacked hero priority; their actual Hand click announces toughen_up_blue above the pending Dodge with Stack2, without a CanPlay precheck. Its printed cost2 is paid from floating resources; both players remain AP0. No defense or damage is added before the layer resolves. It resolves first for defense4; original Dodge resolves second for total defense6. Printed Wounding Blow4 plus real Razor3 gives power7, damage1 and heroHP19. The real Razor hit layer grants go again before the single Resolution AP refund. Actual final pass then Close pins exact UID/owner/LIFO Graveyard order.
